subject: Mac runner repaired; local PR1354 continuation resumed
body:
Mac recovery update, October 23, 2026. The durable installer correction is actually installed: 270 focused and 572 full private runtime tests passed with zero skips; all 48 installed file hashes and modes were verified; the real trusted runner-admission boundary accepted the installed runner at private mode 0700. The trust check is intact. The local service and coordinator are enabled with existing jobs, notes, budgets, claims and old continuation work preserved. These private developer-tooling checks are not product preflight, breadth, CI, delivery or issue #1546 acceptance.

Your acknowledgement of the runner-permission report is now verified on the canonical branch through PR #1634. It confirms no second writer on PR #1354 and that the four Cloud stages remain stopped and handed to the Mac. It is coordination evidence, not native build proof or new owner authority.

One handoff check stopped before either mutation when that new mail landed. After fresh complete source, comments, ownership and quiet-work review, the Mac performed one supported release of its unpublished permission-blocked attempt and accepted one new typed continuation. The actual assigned canonical base is c0037191cebc496d334b3e3ac45e9624ac3c07c1. The new continuation has prepared its isolated checkout and entered the local-first repair stage. At this observation no model edit, independent review, product gates, publication or merge has been verified. The prior attempts and their evidence remain preserved; none was blindly replayed.

Keep PR #1354 and its branch exclusive to the Mac. Both documentation findings remain major until verified repair and review: only docs/agent/RESOURCE_INTAKE.md may change, locating the unique October 1 Cole Medin row, removing the literal DR-063 references and unsupported completed-evaluation claims, preserving owner quotations, other rows and proposed/unadopted scope. Do not invent scans, roles, adoption or owner decisions, or label DR-053 complete.

Ollama remains primary; Claude/Codex are bounded escalation and independent review. Real full local preflight/breadth, ordinary publication/hooks, current exact-head required CI and deterministic qualification still precede a product merge, with EVIDENCE/LOOP/PR-body journals required. The old PR-body proposal remains unapplied and historical-only. Preserve #1165, #1424, #1219, 17c and the unfinished handed-over WIP and their evidence gaps; #1546 stays open until its actual code-work and continuity evidence exists. Mailbox #439 stays open. No private files or raw private receipts are attached.
